resources.string: Sounds a loud alarm whenever a Telegram notification arrives. Give it notification access below, keep the switch on, and leave the app installed.
✅ Notification access granted — the alarm is armed.
⚠️ Notification access NOT granted. Tap the button below to turn it on, or the alarm can\'t see your Telegram notifications.
Grant both of these so your phone doesn\'t quietly shut the watcher down. Strongly recommended on Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo and Huawei phones.
Leave the one you use ticked. The official Telegram app is org.telegram.messenger.
Telegram notification received — tap STOP to silence
The loud alarm that fires on a Telegram notification
The quiet notification shown while the alarm is watching for Telegram messages
